decisions.question: Shape of the project canned-set key
decisions.rationale: Mirrors LOOKUP (patterns -> message) and commit_buckets (ordered list of objects); order is the precedence, which an object cannot carry reliably.

decisions.question: Precedence of project sets against the plugin LOOKUP
decisions.rationale: A project can then replace a built-in message for the same files; the built-in sets still answer when no project set covers the change.

decisions.question: Where build puts a canned path that appeared after capture

options.summary: join the block already carrying that canned message, else a new canned block at the end; pending: block 1
leave it out of the TXT and skip it in coverage

decisions.rationale: The TXT then lists every changed file, so the developer stages the regenerated file with its fixed message; ignoring it would leave an unlisted change behind.

decisions.question: A canned path in the skeleton that vanished before build

options.summary: drop it; drop a block left empty

decisions.rationale: Same rule as an appearance: a canned file's churn has no effect on the run.
